newsitem.title: USA: VIASOFT says will not proceed with offering.
newsitem.headline: VIASOFT says will not proceed with offering.

text.p: VIASOFT Inc said it will not proceed with its previously announced public offering of the its common stock due to market conditions.
The company also said its common stock will not be offered by certain company stockholders as previously announced.

VIASOFT had filed for the offering of 2.0 million shares, including 350,000 shares offered by current holders, to enhance and integrate a newly acquired product line, hire direct sales and research and development employees, take marketing initiatives for potential acquisitions of businesses and other general corporate purposes.

"With the recent disappointing performance of the stock market generally, and technology stocks in particular, we do not believe that the planned offering is in the best interests of the company and its stockholders at this time," said Steven Whiteman, president and chief executive officer.
Whiteman also said "the company has sufficient working capital to meet the liquidity needs of its operations and planned growth for the foreseeable future."
VIASOFT provides integrated technology and specialized professional consulting services designed to enable customers to cost effectively manage and automate their existing applications.
